title: Milestone Score Deduction on Collectible Pickup
explanation: At frame 810 (t=13.66s), collecting a coin while score >= 500 caused score to drop from 500 to 490 instead of increasing to 600. Traced to PlayerData.gd:L40-L41 where an erroneous milestone tax deducts 10 points on subsequent score gains, violating monotonic score progression.
